frontend: existing checked_program.Result from body_semantics and project_trust
cpp_runtime_dependency_scope: Core profile only; optional Python extensions retain their own operator-managed C/C++ runtime dependencies
external_native_tools: CMake for source preparation/install and positional-entry wrappers; ordinary native CLI builds invoke tools directly
Clang C17 only for separate primitive object preparation
external_tool_implementation_limit: Tested LLVM executables are C++ binaries and can depend on libstdc++; no claim of a wholly C++-free compiler/tool installation

optional_python.shutdown: main-thread finalization after owned references and active GIL operations are gone; no reinitialization

target_limit: Windows native LLVM/lld 19.1.7 runs and normal-driver three-stage self-bootstrap are verified without WSL. SDK/developer environment and explicit local tool paths remain required. Other OS/architectures, clean hosts and bare metal are unverified.
output_policy: Refuse existing output including dangling links; CMake publishes executable with NO_REPLACE. No hostile concurrent-filesystem sandbox guarantee.

normal_driver.backend_selection: --backend cpp|llvm or --backend=llvm; C++ is explicit and requires separately supplied prelude/toolchain
normal_driver.native_config: share/wood/native.json: format 1, runtime_abi 4, target, llvm_dir, linker, llvm_wsl
normal_driver.private_transport: Sequential main-thread JSON C ABI; worker calls rejected before shared state access; 64 MiB request and 64 KiB response limits; owned paths, no-shell child groups/jobs and bounded capture/deadlines
normal_driver.sanitizer_flag: Explicitly rejected for freestanding LLVM output; separate hosted sanitizer gates
normal_driver.windows_tool_environment: Tested with explicit Debian LLVM adapter and Windows SDK developer environment

owned concrete closures and COW erased callables
thread-affine database, statement and transaction identities

COW nested lists/dictionaries and balanced ordered indexing

float matmul/affine, math_sqrt and math_finite
flattened array iteration/comprehensions/native cursors and lazy adapters
snapshot list/dict/string/range and cursor/custom-protocol iteration and comprehensions
existing std.functional and lazy std.iter algorithms
stateful callable target validation/reacquisition after argument effects
generic record/tuple/optional value semantics
mutable-path validation and reacquisition after argument effects
readonly receiver borrowing with effectful-argument snapshots
short circuit and comparison chains
if/while/for/break/continue/return
assert/raise/try-except and explicit exit unwinding
binary file read/write/bounded-line/seek/tell/flush/close and stream scopes
all currently lowered value-family formatting with explicit traversal stack and typed layout descriptors
buffered stdin read_line/eof, binary byte preservation and qualified Windows CRT text conversion
public monotonic seconds/nanoseconds and checked sleep through std.time
dictionary removal with COW, insertion order and balanced index preservation
finite decimal/binary64 conversion and formatting
JSON parsing, typed extraction, conversion, sorted dumping and equality
args, binary read_text/write_text, canonical path/trust services, bounded sorted directory listing
full-range binary64 sin/cos with checked nonfinite rejection
C ABI int64/double/void, byte borrows, synchronous scalar callbacks, COW contiguous numeric buffers
actual native compiler staged self-build
native JSON-message tasks with independent contexts, repeated waits, cooperative cancellation, scoped/final joining and original errors/exits
SQLite database/statement/transaction primitives, strict bindings and columns, resource scopes and per-worker connections
runtime: reference-counted owner ABI and generated recursive retain/drop callbacks
checked sequence growth and COW AVL-indexed dictionaries
full-expression/scope/error/exit cleanup and original-handle scope pins
six-field diagnostics with production-compatible invalid UTF-8 replacement
Linux mmap/munmap and binary file syscalls
Windows Kernel32 heap/binary files/UTF-8 paths/stack probes
atomic owner/statistic counters and COW uniqueness loads, synchronized stdin/clock state, per-native-thread callback stacks
optional Linux glibc startup and pthread threads only for used system-library services; ordinary native programs remain freestanding

unsupported: full production distribution qualification and exhaustive full-language qualification
platforms other than qualified Windows/Linux x86-64 profiles

sqlite.external_dependency: Thread-safe SQLite 3.38+, dynamically loaded under the trusted-directory policy
sqlite.linux_service_profile: x86-64 glibc startup/loader and pthread workers; no C++ runtime; selected for used socket/SQLite operations/resources
sqlite.windows_service_profile: Kernel32-only imports; restricted runtime loading of the SQLite system DLL or trusted-directory DLL
sqlite.legacy_abi4: Older ABI-4 runtime objects retain ordinary-program compatibility; using SQLite with an older runtime fails at link time
sqlite.qualification: See the dated SQLite report for exact executed gates and remaining limits

network.dns: OS getaddrinfo policy outside the connection deadline; no invented addresses
network.racing: up to 64 family-interleaved addresses, 250 ms stagger, first success owns its socket and closes losers
network.timeouts: one monotonic deadline per logical connect/accept/read/line/write; buffered data/EOF/empty operations may complete immediately
network.cancellation: cooperative waits/retries, R4022 socket operation cancelled; no forced DNS/foreign-code interruption
network.windows: full-width SOCKET ABI, System32 Winsock loading, SDK-checked layouts; Kernel32-only static imports
network.linux: initialized glibc socket/resolver ABI and pthread workers; per-send MSG_NOSIGNAL

bootstrap_seed_sanitizers: Preserved native seed; generated-code/runtime sanitizer scope recorded separately from ordinary freestanding bootstrap
performance_claim: No performance/peak-memory benchmark under active host load; resource counters and AVL comparison bounds are correctness checks
runtime_extensions: private checked-context helpers and native normal-driver OS bridge
acknowledged null-stdin policy for compiler subprocesses
atomic ownership and worker-local checked contexts
SQLite identities, strict statements, nested transactions and scoped rollback

formatting.descriptor_layout: private additive ABI-4 type/field graph; offsets supplied by LLVM

stdin.windows: CRLF translation, Ctrl-Z EOF, established trailing CR removal
stdin.linux: raw bytes and established trailing CR removal

time.windows: QPC/QPF and Sleep with monotonic deadline recheck
time.epoch: lazy process-local, shared by seconds/ns families

dictionary_remove_complexity: O(n); absent key does not detach; COW allocation precedes logical mutation
compiler_stdin_policy: Optional private process inherit_stdin flag defaults true; compiler tools request false after process_stdin_policy handshake. Old bridges reject the new handshake explicitly.
oom_limit: Qualified MSVC/libstdc++ allocation ceilings differ; native allocation errors have operation context, production bad_alloc is caught at the outer boundary. OOM handler/location equivalence unqualified.

native_sanitizer_scope.c_primitives: Clang ASan+UBSan/leaks and ThreadSanitizer+UBSan; real hosted pthread/allocator/file port; normal objects remain freestanding
native_sanitizer_scope.generated_llvm: ASan and ThreadSanitizer through a real hosted Linux pthread/allocator/file port

thread_safety: Immutable JSON owners may be shared across registered native task workers; atomic RC/COW reads and task publication, worker-local contexts/callback stacks, synchronized stdin/time. No shared mutable Wood values or cross-thread/retained foreign callbacks. Private driver transport remains main-thread only.
independence_limit: Native compiler and normal-driver builds use external LLVM/linker and a prepared freestanding C17 object. Full production-language/service parity, clean-machine installation, all targets and a wholly C++-free external LLVM tool installation are not qualified. See current validation ledger for exact completed gates.

tasks.windows: CreateThread, completion event, SRW locks, cancel flag, wait/join/CloseHandle
tasks.linux: Ordinary profile: fixed SysV clone boundary, 8 MiB stack plus 4 KiB guard, TID/futex join. Optional system-library profile: libc pthread startup/join with ELF TLS.
tasks.worker_context_layout: opaque size/forward/clear APIs preserve existing LLVM context layout
tasks.publication: release/acquire completion and atomic owner references
tasks.cancel: cooperative request; close joins without deadline and does not rethrow worker errors
tasks.wait: 1..86400000 ms; timeout leaves running, repeated result/error/exit propagation
tasks.callbacks: borrowed stack scopes per registered OS thread, restored on reentrant calls; unrelated threads never dereferenced
tasks.io_transfer: Prepare destination, reserve and start worker behind a gate, then perform infallible socket/buffer/TLS handoff. Failed startup retains sender identity. Worker scopes close on normal/error/exit/cancellation paths.
tasks.hosted_sanitizer_port: Real pthread workers instrumented for tests; ordinary compiler/apps do not acquire this dependency, optional system-library apps use initialized libc pthreads.

tls.peer_verification: mandatory trust chain, validity, purpose and DNS/IP SAN
tls.private_keys: unencrypted PEM only; password callback never prompts
tls.bio: stable owned full-width socket; per-send MSG_NOSIGNAL on Linux
tls.lifecycle: close_notify, TCP half-close, bounded drain; abort during unwind or after fatal TLS failure
tls.cancellation: shared cooperative socket wait policy R4022
tls.default_roots: OpenSSL policy, not automatically the Windows certificate store
